- TOTAL revenue reached £109.2k TW versus £88.2k LW, a WoW gain of 23.8%.

- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS recorded £2,264.16 TW and JUMBO BAG PAISLEY PARK £2,120.48 TW, the latter up £2,120.50 WoW.
- The top five products together accounted for 18.2% of TOTAL revenue TW, with ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE RED up £2,082.50 WoW and ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE PINK up 641.9% WoW.
- Largest WoW declines came from LANDMARK FRAME OXFORD STREET at -£3,335.00, LANDMARK FRAME COVENT GARDEN at -£3,316.10 and LANDMARK FRAME LONDON BRIDGE at -£3,166.30.
